jobs.name: Setlist Manager
jobs.does: Maintains and updates setlists for each band member.

jobs.name: Song Tracker
jobs.does: Tracks which band members know which songs.

jobs.name: Metronome and Tuner
jobs.does: Provides real-time metronome and tuner functions.

jobs.name: Gig Scheduler
jobs.does: Schedules and reminds the band of upcoming gigs.

jobs.name: Revenue Splitter
jobs.does: Calculates and splits money from shows among band members.

jobs.name: Practice Log
jobs.does: Tracks practice sessions and their duration.

jobs.name: Reminders
jobs.does: Sends reminders for upcoming gigs and practice sessions.
